name: Server Meshing
description:
Splits a map across several map-server processes ("cells") with seamless handoff, ghosting across cell edges, seams between maps, cells of any size, on-demand ("sleeping") cells, and dynamic cells the central cuts and merges at runtime, by command or by its own load policy.
Dynamic cells are supervised (a dead or hung cell is restarted, a cell cut off from the cluster fences itself), buildings follow the cut, and a restarted central adopts the cut layout and resumes the operation it was running. A world can span several machines, each running its own map spawner: a cut family's cells start, restart and stop on the machine that serves its base. A map can link its cells on demand (each cell only to the cells it needs), so a map is not capped at the 64 links one cell takes.
Players cross a cell edge without a loading screen; neighbouring cells exchange ghosts of everything near their shared edge, so combat, loot, quests and building resolve across it. Empty land costs nothing: a cell with nobody near it does not run.
Subclasses on the kit's managers and entity prefabs plus one world-registry asset; the package changes no kit file. Needs OpenMMORPG v1.1.4 (2026-10-25) or later: the add-on does not compile on an older kit (see the README), or on a build target without the DISABLE_ADDRESSABLES scripting define. Includes a Setup window that validates a project, judges every Dynamic map's cut and settings before anything starts, and fixes what it can.
